description: React component for displaying paginated server logs with scrolling and loading states in the Mattermost admin console.

classes.name: PlainLogList
classes.description: React component class for rendering a paginated log list with auto-scrolling and loading indicator.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting up refs and initial state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Scrolls to the bottom of the log panel after component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Scrolls to the bottom of the log panel after component updates.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles clicking the 'Next' button, disables it temporarily, and calls the nextPage prop.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles clicking the 'Previous' button and calls the previousPage prop.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the log list, navigation buttons, and loading spinner if applicable.
